value.alpha: anomeric exocyclic oxygen cis to oxygen on reference atom in Fischer projection
value.beta: anomeric exocyclic oxygen trans to oxygen on reference atom in Fischer projection
value.reference_plane: perpendicular to Fischer projection and containing all monosaccharide carbon atoms
value.rendering: alpha or beta followed by a hyphen immediately before D or L

value.ring_plane: main hemiacetal ring is in the plane of the paper

value.haworth_anomeric_center: replace formal bonds by H and OH symbols
value.name_prefix: alpha,beta at the front of the name

value.three_to_six_carbons: retained or semisystematic names in Table 10.2

value.qualification: each name is qualified by D or L under P-102.3.2

value.assignment_direction: begin with chirality centers next to aldehydic group
value.citation_order: prefix for group farthest from aldehydic group is cited first

value.more_than_four_centers: two or more appropriate configurational prefixes

value.alpha: anomeric and reference oxygen atoms formally cis in Fischer projection
value.beta: anomeric and reference oxygen atoms formally trans in Fischer projection
value.reference_center: highest-numbered atom in the single-prefix chirality-center group next to the anomeric center and included in the ring

value.value: classified by the lowest locant of the actual or potential carbonyl group

value.carbonyl_at_c3_or_higher: ignore carbonyl and assign prefix or prefixes to chirality centers from Table 10.3
value.numbering: give carbonyl group lowest possible locant
value.parallel_recommended_system: systematic substitutive name may also be supplied
value.stem_transformation: replace aldose stem ending ose by locanted ulose

value.current_status: supersedes former nondetachable treatment; anhydro is likewise detachable
value.meaning: remove an oxy group and rejoin hydrogen

value.deoxy_at_chirality_center: prefer systematic carbohydrate name; substitutive name with CIP descriptors is appropriate
value.retained_name_allowed_when: deoxygenation does not affect configuration at any chirality center
value.same_position_prefixes: amino plus deoxy, or P-59.1.9 always-prefix terms plus deoxy, are allowed
value.six_deoxy_glucose_mannose_galactose: use retained trivial names from P-102.5.3.2

value.configurational_prefix_citation_directio: commence at end farthest from C-1
value.form: locanted deoxy prefix followed by stem and necessary configurational prefixes
value.methylene_between_chirality_sets: ignore CH2 and assign prefixes across the full chirality-center sequence under P-102.5.1.1.3

value.amino_bearing_center_configuration: express as aldose configuration as though amino replaced hydroxy
value.nonanomeric_amino_replacement: treat as amino substitution of corresponding deoxy monosaccharide
value.sulfanyl_replacement: treat as functional replacement using thio
